sn47.27:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
sn47.27:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso asekkho hotīti.
sn47.27:1.5: catunnaṃ kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ samattaṃ bhāvitattā asekkho hoti.
sn47.27:2.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.27:2.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanansaṃ.
sn47.27:2.6: imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ samattaṃ bhāvitattā asekkho hotīti.
